videos.title: Psalms 94:12-13
videos.description:
Psalm 94:12-13 - Berean Standard Bible
12 Blessed is the man You discipline, O LORD, and teach from Your law,
13 to grant him relief from days of trouble, until a pit is dug for the wicked.

videos.title: Psalms 94:11
videos.description:
Psalm 94:11 - Berean Standard Bible
11 The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.

videos.title: Psalms 94:10
videos.description:
Psalm 94:10 - Berean Standard Bible
10 He who admonishes the nations, does He not discipline? He who teaches man, does He lack knowledge?

videos.title: Psalms 94:9
videos.description:
Psalm 94:9 - Berean Standard Bible
9 He who affixed the ear, can He not hear? He who formed the eye, can He not see?

videos.title: Psalms 94:8
videos.description:
Psalm 94:8 - Berean Standard Bible
8 Take notice, O senseless among the people! O fools, when will you be wise?

videos.title: Psalms 94:6-7
videos.description:
Psalm 94:6-7 - Berean Standard Bible
6 They kill the widow and the foreigner; they murder the fatherless.
7 They say, “The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob pays no heed.”

videos.title: Psalms 94:4-5
videos.description:
Psalm 94:4-5 - Berean Standard Bible
4 They pour out arrogant words; all workers of iniquity boast.
5 They crush Your people, O LORD; they oppress Your heritage.

videos.title: Psalms 94:3
videos.description:
Psalm 94:3 - Berean Standard Bible
3 How long will the wicked, O LORD, how long will the wicked exult?

videos.title: Psalms 94:2
videos.description:
Psalm 94:2 - Berean Standard Bible
2 Rise up, O Judge of the earth; render a reward to the proud.

videos.title: Psalms 94:1
videos.description:
Psalm 94:1 - Berean Standard Bible
1 O LORD, God of vengeance, O God of vengeance, shine forth.

videos.title: Psalms 93:2
videos.description:
Psalm 93:2 - Berean Standard Bible
2 Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.

videos.title: Psalms 93:5
videos.description:
Psalm 93:5 - Berean Standard Bible
5 Your testimonies are fully confirmed; holiness adorns Your house, O LORD, for all the days to come.

videos.title: Psalms 93:4
videos.description:
Psalm 93:4 - Berean Standard Bible
4 Above the roar of many waters— the mighty breakers of the sea— the LORD on high is majestic.

videos.title: Psalms 93:3
videos.description:
Psalm 93:3 - Berean Standard Bible
3 The floodwaters have risen, O LORD; the rivers have raised their voice; the seas lift up their pounding waves.

videos.title: Psalms 93:1c
videos.description:
Psalm 93:1 - Berean Standard Bible
1 The LORD reigns! He is robed in majesty; the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength. The world indeed is firmly established; it cannot be moved.

videos.title: Psalms 93:2a-b
videos.description:
Psalm 93:2 - Berean Standard Bible
2 Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.

videos.title: Psalms 92:14-15
videos.description:
Psalm 92:14-15 - Berean Standard Bible
14 In old age they will still bear fruit; healthy and green they will remain,
15 to proclaim, “The LORD is upright; He is my Rock, and in Him there is no unrighteousness.”

videos.title: Psalms 92:12-13
videos.description:
Psalm 92:12-13 - Berean Standard Bible
12 The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
13 Planted in the house of the LORD, they will flourish in the courts of our God.

videos.title: Psalms 92:11
videos.description:
Psalm 92:11 - Berean Standard Bible
11 My eyes see the downfall of my enemies; my ears hear the wailing of my wicked foes.

videos.title: Psalms 92:10
videos.description:
Psalm 92:10 - Berean Standard Bible
10 But You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; with fine oil I have been anointed.

videos.title: Psalms 92:9
videos.description:
Psalm 92:9 - Berean Standard Bible
9 For surely Your enemies, O LORD, surely Your enemies will perish; all evildoers will be scattered.

videos.title: Psalms 92:8
videos.description:
Psalm 92:8 - Berean Standard Bible
8 But You, O LORD, are exalted forever!

videos.title: Psalms 92:6-7
videos.description:
Psalm 92:6-7 - Berean Standard Bible
6 A senseless man does not know, and a fool does not understand,
7 that though the wicked sprout like grass, and all evildoers flourish, they will be forever destroyed.

videos.title: Psalms 92:5
videos.description:
Psalm 92:5 - Berean Standard Bible
5 How great are Your works, O LORD, how deep are Your thoughts!

videos.title: Psalms 92:4
videos.description:
Psalm 92:4 - Berean Standard Bible
4 For You, O LORD, have made me glad by Your deeds; I sing for joy at the works of Your hands.

videos.title: Psalms 92:1-3
videos.description:
Psalm 92:1-3 - Berean Standard Bible
1 A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. It is good to praise the LORD, and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High,
2 to proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning and Your faithfulness at night
3 with the ten-stringed harp and the melody of the lyre.

videos.title: Psalms 92:0
videos.description:
Psalm 92:1 - Berean Standard Bible
1 A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. It is good to praise the LORD, and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High,

videos.title: Psalms 91:16
videos.description:
Psalm 91:16 - Berean Standard Bible
16 With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation.”

videos.title: Psalms 91:15
videos.description:
Psalm 91:15 - Berean Standard Bible
15 When he calls out to Me, I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him and honor him.

videos.title: Psalms 91:14
videos.description:
Psalm 91:14 - Berean Standard Bible
14 “Because he loves Me, I will deliver him; because he knows My name, I will protect him.

videos.title: Psalms 91:13
videos.description:
Psalm 91:13 - Berean Standard Bible
13 You will tread on the lion and cobra; you will trample the young lion and serpent.

videos.title: Psalms 91:11-12
videos.description:
Psalm 91:11-12 - Berean Standard Bible
11 For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.
12 They will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.

videos.title: Psalms 91:9-10
videos.description:
Psalm 91:9-10 - Berean Standard Bible
9 Because you have made the LORD your dwelling— my refuge, the Most High—
10 no evil will befall you, no plague will approach your tent.

videos.title: Psalms 91:10
videos.description:
Psalm 91:10 - Berean Standard Bible
10 no evil will befall you, no plague will approach your tent.

videos.title: Psalms 91:7
videos.description:
Psalm 91:7 - Berean Standard Bible
7 Though a thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand, no harm will come near you.

videos.title: Psalms 91:5-6
videos.description:
Psalm 91:5-6 - Berean Standard Bible
5 You will not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day,
6 nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the calamity that destroys at noon.

videos.title: Psalms 91:4
videos.description:
Psalm 91:4 - Berean Standard Bible
4 He will cover you with His feathers; under His wings you will find refuge; His faithfulness is a shield and rampart.

videos.title: Psalms 91:3
videos.description:
Psalm 91:3 - Berean Standard Bible
3 Surely He will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly plague.

videos.title: Psalms 91:2
videos.description:
Psalm 91:2 - Berean Standard Bible
2 I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”

videos.title: Psalms 91:1
videos.description:
Psalm 91:1 - Berean Standard Bible
1 He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.

videos.title: Psalms 90:17
videos.description:
Psalm 90:17 - Berean Standard Bible
17 May the favor of the Lord our God rest upon us; establish for us the work of our hands— yes, establish the work of our hands!

videos.title: Psalms 90:16
videos.description:
Psalm 90:16 - Berean Standard Bible
16 May Your work be shown to Your servants, and Your splendor to their children.

videos.title: Psalms 90:15
videos.description:
Psalm 90:15 - Berean Standard Bible
15 Make us glad for as many days as You have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

videos.title: Psalms 90:14
videos.description:
Psalm 90:14 - Berean Standard Bible
14 Satisfy us in the morning with Your loving devotion, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.

videos.title: Psalms 90:13
videos.description:
Psalm 90:13 - Berean Standard Bible
13 Return, O LORD! How long will it be? Have compassion on Your servants.

videos.title: Psalms 90:12
videos.description:
Psalm 90:12 - Berean Standard Bible
12 So teach us to number our days, that we may present a heart of wisdom.

videos.title: Psalms 90:11
videos.description:
Psalm 90:11 - Berean Standard Bible
11 Who knows the power of Your anger? Your wrath matches the fear You are due.

videos.title: Psalms 90:10
videos.description:
Psalm 90:10 - Berean Standard Bible
10 The length of our days is seventy years— or eighty if we are strong— yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.

videos.title: Psalms 90:9
videos.description:
Psalm 90:9 - Berean Standard Bible
9 For all our days decline in Your fury; we finish our years with a sigh.

videos.title: Psalms 90:8
videos.description:
Psalm 90:8 - Berean Standard Bible
8 You have set our iniquities before You, our secret sins in the light of Your presence.

videos.title: Psalms 90:7
videos.description:
Psalm 90:7 - Berean Standard Bible
7 For we are consumed by Your anger and terrified by Your wrath.

videos.title: Psalms 90:5-6
videos.description:
Psalm 90:5-6 - Berean Standard Bible
5 You whisk them away in their sleep; they are like the new grass of the morning—
6 in the morning it springs up new, but by evening it fades and withers.

videos.title: Psalms 90:4
videos.description:
Psalm 90:4 - Berean Standard Bible
4 For in Your sight a thousand years are but a day that passes, or a watch of the night.

videos.title: Psalms 90:3
videos.description:
Psalm 90:3 - Berean Standard Bible
3 You return man to dust, saying, “Return, O sons of mortals.”

videos.title: Psalms 90:2
videos.description:
Psalm 90:2 - Berean Standard Bible
2 Before the mountains were born or You brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting You are God.

videos.title: Psalms 90:1
videos.description:
Psalm 90:1 - Berean Standard Bible
1 A prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, You have been our dwelling place through all generations.

videos.title: Psalms 89:52
videos.description:
Psalm 89:52 - Berean Standard Bible
52 Blessed be the LORD forever! Amen and amen.

videos.title: Psalms 89:50-51
videos.description:
Psalm 89:50-51 - Berean Standard Bible
50 Remember, O Lord, the reproach of Your servants, which I bear in my heart from so many people—
51 how Your enemies have taunted, O LORD, and have mocked every step of Your anointed one!

videos.title: Psalms 89:49
videos.description:
Psalm 89:49 - Berean Standard Bible
49 Where, O Lord, is Your loving devotion of old, which You faithfully swore to David?

videos.title: Psalms 89:48
videos.description:
Psalm 89:48 - Berean Standard Bible
48 What man can live and never see death? Can he deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah

videos.title: Psalms 89:47
videos.description:
Psalm 89:47 - Berean Standard Bible
47 Remember the briefness of my lifespan! For what futility You have created all men!

videos.title: Psalms 89:46
videos.description:
Psalm 89:46 - Berean Standard Bible
46 How long, O LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your wrath keep burning like fire?

videos.title: Psalms 89:45
videos.description:
Psalm 89:45 - Berean Standard Bible
45 You have cut short the days of his youth; You have covered him with shame. Selah

videos.title: Psalms 89:44
videos.description:
Psalm 89:44 - Berean Standard Bible
44 You have ended his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.

videos.title: Psalms 89:43
videos.description:
Psalm 89:43 - Berean Standard Bible
43 You have bent the edge of his sword and have not sustained him in battle.

videos.title: Psalms 89:42
videos.description:
Psalm 89:42 - Berean Standard Bible
42 You have exalted the right hand of his foes; You have made all his enemies rejoice.

videos.title: Psalms 89:41
videos.description:
Psalm 89:41 - Berean Standard Bible
41 All who pass by plunder him; he has become a reproach to his neighbors.

videos.title: Psalms 89:40
videos.description:
Psalm 89:40 - Berean Standard Bible
40 You have broken down all his walls; You have reduced his strongholds to rubble.

videos.title: Psalms 89:38
videos.description:
Psalm 89:38 - Berean Standard Bible
38 Now, however, You have spurned and rejected him; You are enraged by Your anointed one.

videos.title: Psalms 89:35-37
videos.description:
Psalm 89:35-37 - Berean Standard Bible
35 Once and for all I have sworn by My holiness— I will not lie to David—
36 his offspring shall endure forever, and his throne before Me like the sun,
37 like the moon, established forever, a faithful witness in the sky.” Selah

videos.title: Psalms 89:34
videos.description:
Psalm 89:34 - Berean Standard Bible
34 I will not violate My covenant or alter the utterance of My lips.

videos.title: Psalms 89:33
videos.description:
Psalm 89:33 - Berean Standard Bible
33 But I will not withdraw My loving devotion from him, nor ever betray My faithfulness.

videos.title: Psalms 89:29
videos.description:
Psalm 89:29 - Berean Standard Bible
29 I will establish his line forever, his throne as long as the heavens endure.

videos.title: Psalms 89:28
videos.description:
Psalm 89:28 - Berean Standard Bible
28 I will forever preserve My loving devotion for him, and My covenant with him will stand fast.

videos.title: Psalms 89:27
videos.description:
Psalm 89:27 - Berean Standard Bible
27 I will indeed appoint him as My firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

videos.title: Psalms 89:26
videos.description:
Psalm 89:26 - Berean Standard Bible
26 He will call to Me, ‘You are my Father, my God, the Rock of my salvation.’

videos.title: Psalms 89:25
videos.description:
Psalm 89:25 - Berean Standard Bible
25 I will set his hand over the sea, and his right hand upon the rivers.

videos.title: Psalms 89:24
videos.description:
Psalm 89:24 - Berean Standard Bible
24 My faithfulness and loving devotion will be with him, and through My name his horn will be exalted.

videos.title: Psalms 89:23
videos.description:
Psalm 89:23 - Berean Standard Bible
23 I will crush his foes before him and strike down those who hate him.

videos.title: Psalms 89:22
videos.description:
Psalm 89:22 - Berean Standard Bible
22 No enemy will exact tribute; no wicked man will oppress him.

videos.title: Psalms 89:21
videos.description:
Psalm 89:21 - Berean Standard Bible
21 My hand will sustain him; surely My arm will strengthen him.

videos.title: Psalms 89:20
videos.description:
Psalm 89:20 - Berean Standard Bible
20 I have found My servant David; with My sacred oil I have anointed him.

videos.title: Psalms 89:19
videos.description:
Psalm 89:19 - Berean Standard Bible
19 You once spoke in a vision; to Your godly ones You said, “I have bestowed help on a warrior; I have exalted one chosen from the people.

videos.title: Psalms 89:18
videos.description:
Psalm 89:18 - Berean Standard Bible
18 Surely our shield belongs to the LORD, and our king to the Holy One of Israel.

videos.title: Psalms 89:17
videos.description:
Psalm 89:17 - Berean Standard Bible
17 For You are the glory of their strength, and by Your favor our horn is exalted.

videos.title: Psalms 89:16
videos.description:
Psalm 89:16 - Berean Standard Bible
16 They rejoice in Your name all day long, and in Your righteousness they exult.

videos.title: Psalms 89:15
videos.description:
Psalm 89:15 - Berean Standard Bible
15 Blessed are those who know the joyful sound, who walk, O LORD, in the light of Your presence.

videos.title: Psalms 89:14
videos.description:
Psalm 89:14 - Berean Standard Bible
14 Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; loving devotion and faithfulness go before You.

videos.title: Psalms 89:13
videos.description:
Psalm 89:13 - Berean Standard Bible
13 Mighty is Your arm; strong is Your hand. Your right hand is exalted.

videos.title: Psalms 89:11
videos.description:
Psalm 89:11 - Berean Standard Bible
11 The heavens are Yours, and also the earth. The earth and its fullness You founded.

videos.title: Psalms 89:10
videos.description:
Psalm 89:10 - Berean Standard Bible
10 You crushed Rahab like a carcass; You scattered Your enemies with Your mighty arm.

videos.title: Psalms 89:9
videos.description:
Psalm 89:9 - Berean Standard Bible
9 You rule the raging sea; when its waves mount up, You still them.

videos.title: Psalms 89:8
videos.description:
Psalm 89:8 - Berean Standard Bible
8 O LORD God of Hosts, who is like You? O mighty LORD, Your faithfulness surrounds You.

videos.title: Psalms 89:7
videos.description:
Psalm 89:7 - Berean Standard Bible
7 In the council of the holy ones, God is greatly feared, and awesome above all who surround Him.

videos.title: Psalms 89:6
videos.description:
Psalm 89:6 - Berean Standard Bible
6 For who in the skies can compare with the LORD? Who among the heavenly beings is like the LORD?

videos.title: Psalms 89:5
videos.description:
Psalm 89:5 - Berean Standard Bible
5 The heavens praise Your wonders, O LORD— Your faithfulness as well— in the assembly of the holy ones.

videos.title: Psalms 89:3-4
videos.description:
Psalm 89:3-4 - Berean Standard Bible
3 You said, “I have made a covenant with My chosen one, I have sworn to David My servant:
4 ‘I will establish your offspring forever and build up your throne for all generations.’” Selah

videos.title: Psalms 89:2
videos.description:
Psalm 89:2 - Berean Standard Bible
2 For I have said, “Loving devotion is built up forever; in the heavens You establish Your faithfulness.”

videos.title: Psalms 89:1
videos.description:
Psalm 89:1 - Berean Standard Bible
1 A Maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing of the loving devotion of the LORD forever; with my mouth I will proclaim Your faithfulness to all generations.

videos.title: Psalms 89:0
videos.description:
Psalm 89:1 - Berean Standard Bible
1 A Maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing of the loving devotion of the LORD forever; with my mouth I will proclaim Your faithfulness to all generations.

videos.title: Psalms 88:18
videos.description:
Psalm 88:18 - Berean Standard Bible
18 You have removed my beloved and my friend; darkness is my closest companion.

videos.title: Psalms 88:17
videos.description:
Psalm 88:17 - Berean Standard Bible
17 All day long they engulf me like water; they enclose me on every side.

videos.title: Psalms 88:16
videos.description:
Psalm 88:16 - Berean Standard Bible
16 Your wrath has swept over me; Your terrors have destroyed me.

videos.title: Psalms 88:14
videos.description:
Psalm 88:14 - Berean Standard Bible
14 Why, O LORD, do You reject me? Why do You hide Your face from me?

videos.title: Psalms 88:13
videos.description:
Psalm 88:13 - Berean Standard Bible
13 But to You, O LORD, I cry for help; in the morning my prayer comes before You.

videos.title: Psalms 88:12
videos.description:
Psalm 88:12 - Berean Standard Bible
12 Will Your wonders be known in the darkness, or Your righteousness in the land of oblivion?

videos.title: Psalms 88:11
videos.description:
Psalm 88:11 - Berean Standard Bible
11 Can Your loving devotion be proclaimed in the grave, Your faithfulness in Abaddon ?

videos.title: Psalms 88:10
videos.description:
Psalm 88:10 - Berean Standard Bible
10 Do You work wonders for the dead? Do departed spirits rise up to praise You? Selah

videos.title: Psalms 88:9
videos.description:
Psalm 88:9 - Berean Standard Bible
9 My eyes grow dim with grief. I call to You daily, O LORD; I spread out my hands to You.

videos.title: Psalms 88:8
videos.description:
Psalm 88:8 - Berean Standard Bible
8 You have removed my friends from me; You have made me repulsive to them; I am confined and cannot escape.

videos.title: Psalms 88:6-7
videos.description:
Psalm 88:6-7 - Berean Standard Bible
6 You have laid me in the lowest Pit, in the darkest of the depths.
7 Your wrath weighs heavily upon me; all Your waves have submerged me. Selah

videos.title: Psalms 88:5
videos.description:
Psalm 88:5 - Berean Standard Bible
5 I am forsaken among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom You remember no more, who are cut off from Your care.

videos.title: Psalms 88:5
videos.description:
Psalm 88:5 - Berean Standard Bible
5 I am forsaken among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom You remember no more, who are cut off from Your care.

videos.title: Psalms 88:4
videos.description:
Psalm 88:4 - Berean Standard Bible
4 I am counted among those descending to the Pit. I am like a man without strength.

videos.title: Psalms 88:3
videos.description:
Psalm 88:3 - Berean Standard Bible
3 For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draws near to Sheol.

videos.title: Psalms 88:2
videos.description:
Psalm 88:2 - Berean Standard Bible
2 May my prayer come before You; incline Your ear to my cry.

videos.title: Psalms 88:1
videos.description:
Psalm 88:1 - Berean Standard Bible
1 A song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. For the choirmaster. According to Mahalath Leannoth. A Maskil of Heman the Ezrahite. O LORD, the God of my salvation, day and night I cry out before You.

videos.title: Psalms 88:0
videos.description:
Psalm 88:1 - Berean Standard Bible
1 A song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. For the choirmaster. According to Mahalath Leannoth. A Maskil of Heman the Ezrahite. O LORD, the God of my salvation, day and night I cry out before You.

videos.title: Psalms 87:7
videos.description:
Psalm 87:7 - Berean Standard Bible
7 Singers and pipers will proclaim, “All my springs of joy are in You.”

videos.title: Psalms 87:6
videos.description:
Psalm 87:6 - Berean Standard Bible
6 The LORD will record in the register of the peoples: “This one was born in Zion.” Selah

videos.title: Psalms 87:5
videos.description:
Psalm 87:5 - Berean Standard Bible
5 And it will be said of Zion: “This one and that one were born in her, and the Most High Himself will establish her.”

videos.title: Psalms 87:4
videos.description:
Psalm 87:4 - Berean Standard Bible
4 “I will mention Rahab and Babylon among those who know Me— along with Philistia, Tyre, and Cush — when I say, ‘This one was born in Zion.’”

videos.title: Psalms 87:3
videos.description:
Psalm 87:3 - Berean Standard Bible
3 Glorious things are ascribed to you, O city of God. Selah

videos.title: Psalms 87:2
videos.description:
Psalm 87:2 - Berean Standard Bible
2 The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

videos.title: Psalms 87:1
videos.description:
Psalm 87:1 - Berean Standard Bible
1 A Psalm of the sons of Korah. A song. He has founded His city on the holy mountains.

videos.title: Psalms 86:17
videos.description:
Psalm 86:17 - Berean Standard Bible
17 Show me a sign of Your goodness, that my enemies may see and be ashamed; for You, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.

videos.title: Psalms 86:16
videos.description:
Psalm 86:16 - Berean Standard Bible
16 Turn to me and have mercy; grant Your strength to Your servant; save the son of Your maidservant.

videos.title: Psalms 86:15
videos.description:
Psalm 86:15 - Berean Standard Bible
15 But You, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness.

videos.title: Psalms 86:14
videos.description:
Psalm 86:14 - Berean Standard Bible
14 The arrogant rise against me, O God; a band of ruthless men seeks my life, with no regard for You.

videos.title: Psalms 86:13
videos.description:
Psalm 86:13 - Berean Standard Bible
13 For great is Your loving devotion to me; You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.

videos.title: Psalms 86:12
videos.description:
Psalm 86:12 - Berean Standard Bible
12 I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify Your name forever.

videos.title: Psalms 86:11
videos.description:
Psalm 86:11 - Berean Standard Bible
11 Teach me Your way, O LORD, that I may walk in Your truth. Give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name.

videos.title: Psalms 86:10
videos.description:
Psalm 86:10 - Berean Standard Bible
10 For You are great and perform wonders; You alone are God.

videos.title: Psalms 86:9
videos.description:
Psalm 86:9 - Berean Standard Bible
9 All the nations You have made will come and bow before You, O Lord, and they will glorify Your name.

videos.title: Psalms 86:8
videos.description:
Psalm 86:8 - Berean Standard Bible
8 O Lord, there is none like You among the gods, nor any works like Yours.

videos.title: Psalms 86:7
videos.description:
Psalm 86:7 - Berean Standard Bible
7 In the day of my distress I call on You, because You answer me.

videos.title: Psalms 86:6
videos.description:
Psalm 86:6 - Berean Standard Bible
6 Hear my prayer, O LORD, and attend to my plea for mercy.

videos.title: Psalms 86:5
videos.description:
Psalm 86:5 - Berean Standard Bible
5 For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.

videos.title: Psalms 86:4
videos.description:
Psalm 86:4 - Berean Standard Bible
4 Bring joy to Your servant, for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.

videos.title: Psalms 86:3
videos.description:
Psalm 86:3 - Berean Standard Bible
3 Be merciful to me, O Lord, for I call to You all day long.

videos.title: Psalms 86:2
videos.description:
Psalm 86:2 - Berean Standard Bible
2 Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You are my God; save Your servant who trusts in You.

videos.title: Psalms 86:1
videos.description:
Psalm 86:1 - Berean Standard Bible
1 A prayer of David. Incline Your ear, O LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

videos.title: Psalms 85:13
videos.description:
Psalm 85:13 - Berean Standard Bible
13 Righteousness will go before Him to prepare the way for His steps.

videos.title: Psalms 85:12
videos.description:
Psalm 85:12 - Berean Standard Bible
12 The LORD will indeed provide what is good, and our land will yield its increase.

videos.title: Psalms 85:11
videos.description:
Psalm 85:11 - Berean Standard Bible
11 Faithfulness sprouts from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.

videos.title: Psalms 85:10
videos.description:
Psalm 85:10 - Berean Standard Bible
10 Loving devotion and faithfulness have joined together; righteousness and peace have kissed.

videos.title: Psalms 85:9
videos.description:
Psalm 85:9 - Berean Standard Bible
9 Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him, that His glory may dwell in our land.

videos.title: Psalms 85:8
videos.description:
Psalm 85:8 - Berean Standard Bible
8 I will listen to what God the LORD will say; for He will surely speak peace to His people and His saints; He will not let them return to folly.

videos.title: Psalms 85:7
videos.description:
Psalm 85:7 - Berean Standard Bible
7 Show us Your loving devotion, O LORD, and grant us Your salvation.

videos.title: Psalms 85:5
videos.description:
Psalm 85:5 - Berean Standard Bible
5 Will You be angry with us forever? Will You draw out Your anger to all generations?

videos.title: Psalms 85:4
videos.description:
Psalm 85:4 - Berean Standard Bible
4 Restore us, O God of our salvation, and put away Your displeasure toward us.

videos.title: Psalms 85:3
videos.description:
Psalm 85:3 - Berean Standard Bible
3 You withheld all Your fury; You turned from Your burning anger.

videos.title: Psalms 85:2
videos.description:
Psalm 85:2 - Berean Standard Bible
2 You forgave the iniquity of Your people; You covered all their sin. Selah

videos.title: Psalms 85:1
videos.description:
Psalm 85:1 - Berean Standard Bible
1 For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. You showed favor to Your land, O LORD; You restored Jacob from captivity.

videos.title: Psalms 85:0

Psalm 85:1 - Berean Standard Bible
1 For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. You showed favor to Your land, O LORD; You restored Jacob from captivity.

videos.title: Psalms 84:12
videos.description:
Psalm 84:12 - Berean Standard Bible
12 O LORD of Hosts, how blessed is the man who trusts in You!

videos.title: Psalms 84:11
videos.description:
Psalm 84:11 - Berean Standard Bible
11 For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.

videos.title: Psalms 84:10
videos.description:
Psalm 84:10 - Berean Standard Bible
10 For better is one day in Your courts than a thousand elsewhere. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.

videos.title: Psalms 84:9
videos.description:
Psalm 84:9 - Berean Standard Bible
9 Take notice of our shield, O God, and look with favor on the face of Your anointed.

videos.title: Psalms 84:8
videos.description:
Psalm 84:8 - Berean Standard Bible
8 O LORD God of Hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah

videos.title: Psalms 84:7
videos.description:
Psalm 84:7 - Berean Standard Bible
7 They go from strength to strength, until each appears before God in Zion.

videos.title: Psalms 84:6
videos.description:
Psalm 84:6 - Berean Standard Bible
6 As they pass through the Valley of Baca, they make it a place of springs; even the autumn rain covers it with pools.

videos.title: Psalms 84:5
videos.description:
Psalm 84:5 - Berean Standard Bible
5 Blessed are those whose strength is in You, whose hearts are set on pilgrimage.

videos.title: Psalms 84:4
videos.description:
Psalm 84:4 - Berean Standard Bible
4 How blessed are those who dwell in Your house! They are ever praising You. Selah

videos.title: Psalms 84:3
videos.description:
Psalm 84:3 - Berean Standard Bible
3 Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she places her young near Your altars, O LORD of Hosts, my King and my God.

videos.title: Psalms 84:2
videos.description:
Psalm 84:2 - Berean Standard Bible
2 My soul longs, even faints, for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

videos.title: Psalms 83:18
videos.description:
Psalm 83:18 - Berean Standard Bible
18 May they know that You alone, whose name is the LORD, are Most High over all the earth.

videos.title: Psalms 83:17
videos.description:
Psalm 83:17 - Berean Standard Bible
17 May they be ever ashamed and terrified; may they perish in disgrace.

videos.title: Psalms 83:16
videos.description:
Psalm 83:16 - Berean Standard Bible
16 Cover their faces with shame, that they may seek Your name, O LORD.

videos.title: Psalms 83:14-15
videos.description:
Psalm 83:14-15 - Berean Standard Bible
14 As fire consumes a forest, as a flame sets the mountains ablaze,
15 so pursue them with Your tempest, and terrify them with Your storm.

videos.title: Psalms 83:13
videos.description:
Psalm 83:13 - Berean Standard Bible
13 Make them like tumbleweed, O my God, like chaff before the wind.

videos.title: Psalms 83:11
videos.description:
Psalm 83:11 - Berean Standard Bible
11 Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, and all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

videos.title: Psalms 83:9-10
videos.description:
Psalm 83:9-10 - Berean Standard Bible
9 Do to them as You did to Midian, as to Sisera and Jabin at the River Kishon,
10 who perished at Endor and became like dung on the ground.

videos.title: Psalms 83:8
videos.description:
Psalm 83:8 - Berean Standard Bible
8 Even Assyria has joined them, lending strength to the sons of Lot. Selah

videos.title: Psalms 83:6-7
videos.description:
Psalm 83:6-7 - Berean Standard Bible
6 the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, of Moab and the Hagrites,
7 of Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek, of Philistia with the people of Tyre.

videos.title: Psalms 83:5
videos.description:
Psalm 83:5 - Berean Standard Bible
5 For with one mind they plot together, they form an alliance against You—

videos.title: Psalms 83:3-4
videos.description:
Psalm 83:3-4 - Berean Standard Bible
3 With cunning they scheme against Your people and conspire against those You cherish,
4 saying, “Come, let us erase them as a nation; may the name of Israel be remembered no more.”

videos.title: Psalms 83:2
videos.description:
Psalm 83:2 - Berean Standard Bible
2 See how Your enemies rage, how Your foes have reared their heads.

videos.title: Psalms 83:1
videos.description:

1 A song. A Psalm of Asaph. O God, be not silent; be not speechless; be not still, O God.

videos.title: Psalms 83:0
videos.description:
Psalm 83:1 - Berean Standard Bible
1 A song. A Psalm of Asaph. O God, be not silent; be not speechless; be not still, O God.

videos.title: Psalms 82:8
videos.description:

8 Arise, O God, judge the earth, for all the nations are Your inheritance.

videos.title: Psalms 82:7
videos.description:
Psalm 82:7 - Berean Standard Bible
7 But like mortals you will die, and like rulers you will fall.”

videos.title: Psalms 82:6
videos.description:
Psalm 82:6 - Berean Standard Bible
6 I have said, ‘You are gods; you are all sons of the Most High.’

videos.title: Psalms 82:5
videos.description:
Psalm 82:5 - Berean Standard Bible
5 They do not know or understand; they wander in the darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.

videos.title: Psalms 82:4
videos.description:
Psalm 82:4 - Berean Standard Bible
4 Rescue the weak and needy; save them from the hand of the wicked.

videos.title: Psalms 82:3
videos.description:
Psalm 82:3 - Berean Standard Bible
3 Defend the cause of the weak and fatherless; uphold the rights of the afflicted and oppressed.

videos.title: Psalms 82:2
videos.description:

1 A Psalm of Asaph. God presides in the divine assembly; He renders judgment among the gods:

videos.title: Psalms 81:16
videos.description:
Psalm 81:16 - Berean Standard Bible
16 But I would feed you the finest wheat; with honey from the rock I would satisfy you.”

videos.title: Psalms 81:15
videos.description:
Psalm 81:15 - Berean Standard Bible
15 Those who hate the LORD would feign obedience, and their doom would last forever.

videos.title: Psalms 81:13-14
videos.description:
Psalm 81:13-14 - Berean Standard Bible
13 If only My people would listen to Me, if Israel would follow My ways,
14 how soon I would subdue their enemies and turn My hand against their foes!

videos.title: Psalms 81:12
videos.description:
Psalm 81:12 - Berean Standard Bible
12 So I gave them up to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices.

videos.title: Psalms 81:11
videos.description:
Psalm 81:11 - Berean Standard Bible
11 But My people would not listen to Me, and Israel would not obey Me.

videos.title: Psalms 81:10
videos.description:
Psalm 81:10 - Berean Standard Bible
10 I am the LORD your God, who brought you up out of Egypt. Open wide your mouth, and I will fill it.

videos.title: Psalms 81:9
videos.description:
Psalm 81:9 - Berean Standard Bible
9 There must be no strange god among you, nor shall you bow to a foreign god.

videos.title: Psalms 1:4-6
videos.description:
Psalm 1:4-6 - Berean Standard Bible
4 Not so the wicked! For they are like chaff driven off by the wind.
5 Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
6 For the LORD guards the path of the righteous, but the way of the wicked will perish.
